LEGEND
Blue dashed = ordinary peering; purple dotted = UDR / policy steering.
Orange = encrypted transport; teal = post-inspection delivery.
Grey dashed, no arrows = NIC ownership, NOT packet flow.
NIC labels name their VM; router = 3 NICs, firewall = 2 NICs.
READ THIS AS A -> B; B -> A AND RESPONSES USE THE SAME PIPELINE.
4 VNets | 5 Ubuntu VMs | 9 NICs | 2 tunnels | original inner addresses.
No Azure VPN gateways, cross-side peering or firewall VPN termination.
ARM test management; manual SSH via routers, operator IPv4 /32 only.
CUSTOMER LIFECYCLE TEST | 192.168.77.0/24 + workload VM: CREATED, TESTED, THEN REMOVED.
Customer-only: peering + UDRs + delivery-table update; deleted prefix explicitly unreachable.
24 original-source deliveries + 6 selective denials; removal/no-loop checks passed.
CAVEAT: combined runs after DNS/shutdown interruption; audited redundant DHCP rule difference after reboot.
Not an uninterrupted lifecycle or production multi-customer qualification; service/tunnel overlaps excluded.
